summary: Ambev S.A. filed a Form 6-K covering monthly share buyback transactions under CVM Instruction 44/2021. In April 2026, the company purchased 24 million common shares in twelve separate trades via Santander Corretora, at prices ranging from R$15.23 to R$16.15 per share, totaling approximately R$373.9 million. The shares were acquired for treasury, positioning Ambev as issuer and buyer. The filing provides trade-level details but omits program duration, total authorized amount, or stated rationale—repurchases may signal capital return or offset dilution. Investors should monitor any broader buyback program disclosures and the impact on shares outstanding.
